decisions.decision: Consensus to wait and see how it goes staying with the 53D, not moving the revolving account to a 53E1/2 now. No vote recorded.
decisions.quote: karin asked the group if anyone disagreed with waiting and see how it goes staying with a 53d. dave agreed

decisions.decision: The group settled on beach rental rates: $50 per hour for the beach and beach house, a $50 non refundable deposit, and $25 per hour per lifeguard if required. No vote recorded.
decisions.quote: the group settled on $50 per hour for the rental of the beach and beach house, $50 non refundable deposit and if lifeguards required an additional

decisions.decision: Karin will work with Kayla to update the beach rental policy before the group considers it for approval.

decisions.decision: Marshall Park master planning held over to the March 29 meeting.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Counsel's reading that a balance over $10k may be carried forward if committed and reserved; the 53D funds would stay put and not move to a 53E1/2.
budget_items.quote: as long as funds in excess of $10k were committed and reserved for a particular purpose that a balance over $10k can be carried forward.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ana questioned whether the $25 security deposit is adequate; Kayla said it covers damage and cancellation.
budget_items.quote: ana asked if the $25 security deposit was for damage to the property or if they cancelled.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Rental rates settled by the group: hourly rate for beach and beach house, non-refundable deposit, and per-hour lifeguard charge.
budget_items.quote: the group settled on $50 per hour for the rental of the beach and beach house, $50 non refundable deposit and if lifeguards required an additional

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fee structure accepted: resident and non-resident adult, child, senior and family/individual pass rates, and an add-on charge for additional dependents.
budget_items.quote: resident individual pass: $44.00 non-resident individual pass: $60.00

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Karin reported the town beach salary line is $20k and has been exceeded in recent years; she said covering lifeguard cost through fees would price the beach out of the market.
budget_items.quote: karin said that our town beach salary line is $20k and we have exceeded that the past few years.
